{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Prisoner_Immobilization_Unit_drawing.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Prisoner Immobilization Unit]]
The '''Prisoner Immobilization Unit''' was a portable electronic device used to subdue and "brainwash" [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] prisoners. The device fit over the head and shoulders of its victim.<ref name="Kenner ITT">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|pack=Imperial Troop Transporter|link=vintTroopTransport.asp}}</ref>

The devices were used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Empire's [[Reconnaissance Troop Transporter]]s were equipped with the units.<ref name="ITT comic">[[Imperial troop transporter (story booklet)|Imperial troop transporter story booklet]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Prisoner_Immobilization_Unit-SWGalaxy4.jpg|200px|thumb|Leia wears an Immobilization Unit in trading card art]]
The [[Imperial troop transporter (story booklet)|''Imperial troop transporter'']] comic book that came packaged with [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] Imperial Troop Transporter toy erroneously used this device's name to refer to the [[Droid Prisoner Compartment]], but the mistake was corrected later in the story.<ref name="ITT comic" /> The original toy released in [[1979]] as part of the [[Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|''Star Wars'' toy line]] came with two of these units,<ref name="Kenner ITT" /> as did the slightly modified and renamed "Imperial Cruiser" toy from Kenner's [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' toy line]].<ref name="Kenner Cruiser">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|pack=Imperial Cruiser|altlink=http://theswca.com/images-toys/figuretoys/impcruiser.html}}</ref>

A [[2009 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 4]] trading card featured art by [[Matt Busch]] portraying an "imaginary scenario" of stormtroopers traveling in a Troop Transporter having captured [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]]. The princess is shown wearing a Prisoner Immobilization Unit over her head. The design of the vehicle matches the toy design exactly.<ref name="SWG4">{{Topps|set=2009 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 4|cardname=Abducting a Princess|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/75146/cid/6271156/2009-Topps-Star-Wars-Galaxy-4-41-Abducting-a-Princess}}</ref>
